title: Basic Calculator
statement_short: Given a string s representing a valid mathematical expression containing non-negative integers, '+', '-', '(', ')', and spaces ' ', evaluate the expression and return its result.
constraints: 1 <= s.length <= 3 \* 10^5, s consists of digits, '+', '-', '(', ')', and ' '
hint: String length up to 3 \* 10^5 demands an O(n) time solution, using a stack to manage parenthesis sign changes.
why_not: Right: Stack tracks signs and running evaluation sums across nested parenthesis sub-expressions in O(n) time and O(n) space. Not Backtracking: Recursive branch exploration causes redundant work and potential call-stack overflow on deep expressions. Not 1D DP: Dynamic programming state caching does not apply to sequential expression evaluation. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointer pairs cannot track nested parenthesis operator precedence and sign flips.
